postgreSqlChecks: A drifted browser grant refuses installation atomically. The complete reviewed predecessor accepts the draft.
Erasure start waited for the admitted block. Review includes that write and inactive rows with a timezone-independent digest and no peer identifiers.
Fresh blocks, unblocks, exact replay and direct table writes involving a frozen account are refused. Blocks keep older posts and messages hidden while those phases are pending.
A block on a different pair waited behind erasure start, then saw the frozen peer and failed.
Browser and service roles cannot inspect or erase private rows. Owners must supply the exact processing account and provider binding.
Identity removal waits for the block phase. Unapproved or altered scope fails, and a failure writing the final receipt rolls back removal of every reviewed block.
Overlapping erasures serialize and the second owner must review again. The first retry reuses its time, the unrelated block stays intact, and the frozen member cannot receive new messages.
Wallet-only identity removal verifies after the block receipts. A provider-only account can prepare identity removal without a block receipt. The public status receipt stays pending.
The 67-table reference catches a restore missing the receipts. The full restore preserves exact retry, frozen blocks and the unrelated row.
appCompatibilityScope: Local browser-account HTTP, member block management and shared host tests with the earlier compatible database fixtures. The new erasure SQL ran against PostgreSQL 17 in the full migration rehearsal.
scope: Disposable PostgreSQL 17 with synthetic accounts and no hosted credentials or writes. Production backup and recovery, data retention approval, hosted rollout and installed device acceptance remain pending.
